_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Lost Royalty#001.src: Oh, hello there! I had hoped not to bother you, adventurer, but this is urgent.
Lost Royalty#001.dst: 오, 안녕하세요! 폐를 끼치고 싶진 않았지만, 급한 일이에요, 모험가님.
Lost Royalty#001.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#002.src: You see, the king is very... erm, distracted, and you are just the kind of willing, able-bodied person I need.
Lost Royalty#002.dst: 그게, 왕께서 지금... 음, 경황이 없으시고, 당신은 딱 제게 필요한 의욕 있고 튼튼한 사람이거든요.
Lost Royalty#002.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#003.src: You see, the king's son has gone missing, and with him worrying so much, the problems of the city have festered unsolved.
Lost Royalty#003.dst: 사실 왕자님이 실종되셨어요. 왕께서 걱정만 하시니 도시의 문제들은 해결되지 못하고 곪아 가고 있죠.
Lost Royalty#003.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#004.src: We believe he was kidnapped by the splinter cell mercenaries in the jungle... Unfortunate, too. They used to be quite honourable.
Lost Royalty#004.dst: 정글의 분리파 용병들에게 납치된 것 같아요... 안타깝죠. 예전엔 꽤 명예로운 자들이었는데.
Lost Royalty#004.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#005.src: Well, anyway, they're usually spotted outside the run-down farm outside of town. Go there and see what they want in return for the young prince.
Lost Royalty#005.dst: 아무튼, 그들은 주로 마을 밖 허물어진 농장 근처에서 목격돼요. 거기 가서 왕자님을 돌려주는 대가로 뭘 원하는지 알아봐 주세요.
Lost Royalty#005.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#006.src: Talk to the Mercenary Leader in their hideout outside {p}
Lost Royalty#006.dst: {p} 외곽의 은신처에 있는 용병 대장에게 말을 거세요

Lost Royalty#007.src: Excuse me?! What are you doing here, how did you find our secret hideout?
Lost Royalty#007.dst: 뭐야?! 여기서 뭐 하는 거지, 우리 비밀 은신처는 어떻게 찾았어?
Lost Royalty#007.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#008.src: Oh, you're here for the boy? A mighty fine steal, that one! The boy won't be leaving this establishment for free. I'll need some nice loot for him.
Lost Royalty#008.dst: 오, 그 꼬마 때문에 왔나? 그 녀석은 아주 괜찮은 수확이지! 공짜로는 못 내보내. 쓸 만한 전리품을 좀 가져와야겠어.
Lost Royalty#008.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#009.src: Ah, but what to have you fetch...oh, haha! This would be a perfect opportunity to obtain that... Alright, ears open!
Lost Royalty#009.dst: 아, 근데 뭘 가져오라고 할까... 오, 하하! 그걸 손에 넣을 절호의 기회로군... 좋아, 잘 들어!
Lost Royalty#009.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#010.src: There's a certain talisman that we aren't able to get to in the temple not far from here. It has special abilities that allow my men to be strengthened, see.
Lost Royalty#010.dst: 여기서 멀지 않은 신전에 우리가 못 가져오는 호부이 하나 있어. 내 부하들을 강화해 주는 특별한 힘이 있거든.
Lost Royalty#010.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#011.src: The guardians there pack quite the punch, and there's some nasty mechanism in the way that we just can't crack.
Lost Royalty#011.dst: 거기 수호자들은 꽤 세고, 길목엔 도저히 못 뚫는 고약한 장치가 있어.
Lost Royalty#011.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#012.src: The temple is found just across the waterway, in a crevice in the mountain. It used to be blocked until those WynnExcavation fellows tried digging there.
Lost Royalty#012.dst: 신전은 수로 바로 건너편 산 틈새에 있어. 원래 막혀 있었는데 WynnExcavation 녀석들이 거길 파헤쳤지.
Lost Royalty#012.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#013.src: You get that talisman in my hands, and the king's boy is yours. Now off you pip! I'm a very busy man.
Lost Royalty#013.dst: 그 호부을 내 손에 쥐여 주면 왕자는 네 거다. 자, 어서 가! 난 아주 바쁜 사람이야.
Lost Royalty#013.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#014.src: Go to the jungle temple and retrieve the talisman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost Royalty#015.src: Bring the talisman back to the Mercenary Leader.

Lost Royalty#016.src: You've gotten the talisman! I can't believe you actually got through that puzzle!
Lost Royalty#016.dst: 호부을 가져왔군! 그 퍼즐을 정말 풀었다니 믿기지 않는데!
Lost Royalty#016.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#017.src: At this point I would usually keep the kid and throw you out of here, but since you've done what I've asked in such a timely fashion, he's all yours.
Lost Royalty#017.dst: 보통 이쯤이면 꼬마는 잡아 두고 널 쫓아내겠지만, 부탁한 걸 이렇게 빨리 해 줬으니 녀석은 데려가.
Lost Royalty#017.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#018.src: When you get back to whoever asked you to do this, tell him to leave my men and I alone! We guildsmen lay down our lives every day, we don't need any more hostile onlookers!
Lost Royalty#018.dst: 이 일 시킨 놈한테 돌아가거든, 나와 내 부하들 좀 내버려 두라고 전해! 우린 매일 목숨 걸고 산다고, 적대적인 구경꾼은 더 필요 없어!
Lost Royalty#018.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#019.src: Talk to the Prince of {p} in the jail cell

Lost Royalty#020.src: Report back to Yavlis with the news

Lost Royalty#021.src: Ah, finally! You're back. Did they let you bring him back? Those mercenaries have an awful habit of failing to honour their deals.
Lost Royalty#021.dst: 아, 드디어! 돌아오셨군요. 왕자님을 데려가게 해 줬나요? 그 용병들은 약속을 안 지키는 고약한 버릇이 있거든요.
Lost Royalty#021.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#022.src: Wait, the prince said what? He truly wants to be a mercenary? Oh my... then he must have escaped on his own.
Lost Royalty#022.dst: 잠깐, 왕자님이 뭐라고요? 정말 용병이 되고 싶으시대요? 세상에... 그럼 스스로 도망치신 거군요.
Lost Royalty#022.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#023.src: Alright then, if that's the path the king's son chooses to walk, then there's nothing we can do.
Lost Royalty#023.dst: 그래요, 그게 왕자님이 택한 길이라면 우리가 어쩔 수 없죠.
Lost Royalty#023.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#024.src: I can only hope that he chose to join them out of a will to protect the people, rather than simply brutishness or money.
Lost Royalty#024.dst: 단순한 폭력이나 돈이 아니라, 백성을 지키려는 마음으로 합류하셨기를 바랄 뿐이에요.
Lost Royalty#024.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#025.src: Such a shame that old guild has stooped to such a level. Well, we must thank you for your help. You can have the emerald ransom we had intended to pay.
Lost Royalty#025.dst: 그 오래된 길드가 이렇게까지 타락하다니 안타깝네요. 아무튼 도와주셔서 감사해요. 몸값으로 준비한 에메랄드를 드릴게요.
Lost Royalty#025.speaker: Yavlis
